# Requirements Quality Checklist: Punch Refusal & FR-013a's Reader Guarantee

**Purpose**: Validate the *requirements writing* for the 2026-09-16 hard-refusal decision —
FR-012, FR-012a–c, FR-013, FR-013a–c, FR-015, FR-015a — with particular weight on FR-013a's
claim that a refused day reads as no punch to **every** later reader
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Scope note**: `requirements.md` (spec quality, 15/16) is a separate artifact and is not duplicated
here. This checklist covers User Story 3's refusal path only — the fuel half (US1, US2) is
`bugs.md` item 13 and is not in scope.

## Requirement Completeness — FR-013a's reader guarantee

- [ ] CHK001 Are the "later readers" FR-013a binds actually enumerated in the requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013a] — the requirement names payroll, labour cost and project roll-up by example; a guarantee over an unenumerated set cannot be discharged
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for how a **new** reader added later inherits FR-013a's guarantee? [Gap] — the guarantee is structural in the plan (refusals are not in the attendance table) but no requirement states that as the mechanism
- [ ] CHK003 Is it specified whether a refused day must be distinguishable from a day the employee did not attempt at all, and to whom? [Gap, Ambiguity] — FR-013a requires both read as "no punch"; FR-013c keeps a log that distinguishes them, and no requirement says who may see the difference
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for how a refused day is treated by absence, leave-balance and disciplinary calculations? [Coverage, Gap] — these are readers FR-013a binds without naming, and each has a different correct answer
- [ ] CHK005 Is it specified whether the refusal log may ever be joined to attendance for reporting? [Gap, Spec §FR-013c] — FR-013c forbids approving a refusal into a present day; it does not address read-only correlation

## Requirement Completeness — the accuracy threshold

- [ ] CHK006 Is the default value of the accuracy maximum stated in the requirements, or only the fact that it is configurable? [Gap, Spec §FR-012b] — the 50-metre default appears in the clarification and the plan; FR-012b says only "defaulting to 50 metres"
- [ ] CHK007 Are bounds specified for the configurable accuracy maximum? [Gap, Spec §FR-012b] — the spec's edge case notes a 500-metre tolerance on a 100-metre fence swallows the fence, and explicitly declines to cap it; confirm that non-cap is a stated decision rather than an omission
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for a punch that reports **no** accuracy at all? [Gap, Spec §FR-012a] — plan D21 decides `?? 0`, which is the entire backward-compatibility story for every client shipped today, and no requirement states it
- [ ] CHK009 Is the precedence between the unlocatable refusal and the accuracy allowance specified as a requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012a] — plan D21 orders them deliberately; FR-012a describes both without fixing the order, and the wrong order lets a poor fix be admitted by its own imprecision
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements defined for whether the accuracy value can be trusted, or for bounding a hostile value? [Gap, Security] — research §2 reasons about it; no requirement constrains it
- [ ] CHK011 Is it specified whether the threshold applies to supervisor-marked labour attendance as well as self-service punches? [Gap, Consistency] — feature 013 has its own 50-metre threshold for muster fixes, and research §3 deliberately leaves it alone

## Requirement Completeness — the refusal log

- [ ] CHK012 Are the fields FR-013c requires actually specified, or only its purpose? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013c] — the requirement says "who attempted, when, where, and which check failed"; whether that includes reported accuracy, distance or match distance is decided only in data-model.md
- [ ] CHK013 Is a retention period specified for refusal log entries? [Gap] — research §5 records that nobody has asked; confirm that is an accepted state rather than an oversight
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements defined for who may read the refusal log, distinctly from who may read attendance? [Gap, Spec §FR-013c] — the log holds location and failed-verification facts about a named person and is more sensitive than the attendance it replaces
- [ ] CHK015 Is the decision not to retain a refused punch's photo recorded as a requirement? [Traceability, Gap] — plan D20 and research §4 argue it; no requirement states it, so nothing prevents a later change adding the column back
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for detecting a pattern of refusals against one employee? [Gap] — research §1 justifies the log's existence partly on impersonation detection, which no requirement asks for

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK017 Does FR-013 specify that "no attendance record" includes pending, unapproved and rejected states explicitly enough to bind an implementer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK018 Is "photo verification fails" defined to cover both a mismatch and an undetectable face? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012] — data-model.md separates the two reasons; FR-012 speaks of validating "against the employee's enrolled face"
- [ ] CHK019 Is FR-013b's "in the response to the refused attempt" specific enough to require a machine-readable code rather than prose? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013b] — plan D18 specifies stable codes; the requirement says "the failing check and its reason"
- [ ] CHK020 Is "unlocatable" defined in the requirements as a distinct outcome from "outside the fence"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012a]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK021 Do FR-013 and FR-015 agree, now that FR-015 no longer promises after-the-fact visibility in attendance? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK022 Is FR-012c's reliance on feature 003's existing threshold consistent with FR-012b making the *location* threshold company-configurable? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012b, §FR-012c] — one threshold is a Super Admin setting and the other is deployment config, and the requirements do not explain why they differ
- [ ] CHK023 Does any remaining requirement or success criterion still assume a refused punch reaches a reviewer? [Conflict, Spec §SC-004] — SC-004 speaks of punches "validated against an assigned location or an explicit mobile exemption"; confirm no criterion survives from the exception-for-review era
- [ ] CHK024 Are FR-015a and feature 016's FR-012 consistent about which artifact enters the approval chain? [Consistency, Cross-feature] — both were amended on the same date and each references the other
- [ ] CHK025 Is the mobile exemption (FR-014) consistent with the hard refusal — is a mobile employee exempt from the face check too, or only from location? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK026 Is SC-005's "verified across every punch path" measurable — are the punch paths enumerable from the requirements? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK027 Are acceptance criteria defined for the accuracy allowance's arithmetic, as distinct from the threshold being configurable? [Gap, Spec §SC-005b] — SC-005b covers the setting taking effect; nothing measures that distance ≤ radius + accuracy is the rule applied
- [ ] CHK028 Can SC-005a's "every day lost to a refused punch that was genuinely worked is recoverable" be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005a] — "genuinely worked" is not a property the system holds
- [ ] CHK029 Are acceptance criteria defined for the refusal rate the client accepted blind? [Gap] — plan phase 2 exists to measure it; no success criterion names a threshold or requires the measurement

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for an offline-queued punch refused on sync, days after it was taken? [Coverage, Gap] — the punch path already supports an offline window, and a refusal arriving days late has no recovery route the employee can act on
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for a punch-**out** refused after an accepted punch-in? [Coverage, Gap] — the day then holds an open punch-in that nothing can close, which the existing FR-008a behaviour treats as non-blocking
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for both a location and a face failure on the same punch — which refusal is reported? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements defined for an employee whose assignment changes between a punch being taken and being synced? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011] — research §5 keys resolution on the punch's day; no requirement states it
- [ ] CHK034 Are recovery requirements defined for the window where the hard refusal ships but 016's correction chain does not? [Coverage, Exception Flow] — the spec's Assumptions name the ordering constraint; no requirement enforces it

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK035 Is the behaviour specified when an employee has no assigned location **and** their site has no geofence configured? [Coverage, Gap] — FR-016 falls back to the site fence; a site without one is not addressed
- [ ] CHK036 Are requirements defined for an employee with no face enrolment attempting a punch under the hard refusal? [Coverage, Gap] — today this is a 400 before validation; whether it is now a refusal and logged as one is unstated
- [ ] CHK037 Is the interaction between the payroll lock and a refusal specified — which is reported when both apply? [Coverage, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK038 Does NFR-001's 2-second target cover the refusal path as well as the accepted path? [Coverage, Spec §NFR-001]
- [ ] CHK039 Are requirements defined to prevent the refusal path adding cost to the accepted path? [Gap, NFR] — stated as a constraint in the plan's Technical Context; not a requirement
- [ ] CHK040 Are requirements defined for the storage and growth of refusal rows under a high-refusal deployment? [Gap, NFR]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK041 Is the dependency on feature 016's correction chain written as a requirement, or does it remain an assumption? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions] — it is the single most consequential ordering constraint in this feature
- [ ] CHK042 Is the assumption that face matching is unchanged from feature 003 validated against 003's own requirements? [Assumption, Spec §FR-012c]
- [ ] CHK043 Is the client's acceptance of the GPS-drift consequence recorded in the requirements as a decision with a named owner? [Traceability, Spec §Clarifications] — it is recorded as a clarification; confirm that is sufficient provenance for a decision that costs paid days

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- This is the first custom checklist for 020, so IDs start at CHK001
- **The heaviest cluster is CHK001–CHK005, FR-013a's reader guarantee.** It is written as a promise
  over an unenumerated set of readers, which is the one requirement in this feature that cannot be
  discharged by inspection — and the one whose failure pays somebody for a refused day
